d: Donald Trump once called Zohran Mamdani a “Communist lunatic” and Abdul El-Sayed a “jihadist”. Today, both Democrats have found an unexpected opening with the US President. El-Sayed's cheeky “Trumpcare” proposal has even earned Trump's praise, raising questions about his sudden change of tone. From political insults to Oval Office diplomacy, what explains Trump's unlikely warmth towards former adversaries? Is it ego, political strategy or a desire for bipartisan deals? We examine how Mamdani and El-Sayed turned confrontation into negotiation, why Trump's enemies can become his allies, and…
